---

## Technical Analysis: Tutors Live/Presence System

### Architecture Overview

The system uses a two-layer architecture: **PartyKit** (WebSocket relay via partysocket) for real-time presence, and **Supabase** for persistent analytics storage. Three services operate together: `presenceService` (per-course student tracking), `liveService` (platform-wide dashboard), and `analyticsService` (duration/interaction persistence).

### Data Captured in Real-Time (the `LoRecord` structure)

Every navigation event broadcasts this payload via PartyKit:

- `courseId`, `courseUrl`, `courseTitle` -- which course
- `loRoute` -- the exact learning object route (e.g., `/lab/topic-1/unit-2/lab-name`)
- `title` -- the learning object's title
- `type` -- the LO type (e.g., `web`, `lab`, `talk`, `note`, `panelvideo`, etc.)
- `img` / `icon` -- visual identifier of the LO
- `isPrivate` -- whether the course is private
- `user: { fullName, avatar, id, sentiment }` -- who is viewing it

This is **page-level** tracking only. There is no click-level tracking, no scroll depth, and no dwell/time-on-page in the real-time layer. Every time a student navigates to a learning object, `sendLoEvent()` fires and broadcasts the `LoRecord` JSON to two PartyKit rooms: `"tutors-all-course-access"` (global) and the course-specific room (keyed by `courseId`).

### What the Lecturer Sees

**Global live dashboard** (`/live`): Three tabs -- Courses (which courses have active users, showing the latest LO someone accessed), Students (all students across all courses), and Groups (courses grouped). Each shows a count badge.

**Per-course live page** (`/live/[courseid]`): Shows "Online right now" (real-time via PartyKit WebSocket) plus "Latest activity" with tabs for Today/This Week/This Month/This Year (pulled from Supabase `tutors-connect-latest` table). Each student appears as a `StudentCard` showing: student name (linked to GitHub profile), avatar, their sentiment emoji, the LO title they last viewed, the LO type with icon, and the LO image/icon. Anonymous users are filtered out.

**OnlineButton** (sidebar): While browsing a course, the lecturer can click "View N Online" to see a sidebar listing currently online students and what each is viewing.

### Persistence Layer (Supabase)

Each presence event also calls `upsertTutorsConnectLatestLo()`, writing one row per (course_id, student_id) to `tutors-connect-latest` with the full `LoRecord` as a JSON `payload` column and a `received_at` timestamp. This is an upsert on `(course_id, student_id)`, meaning only the **most recent** LO per student is stored -- no history.

The `analyticsService` separately tracks `learning_records` (per student/course/LO with `duration` and `count` increments) and a `calendar` table (per student/course/date with `timeactive` and `pageloads`). Duration is incremented by calling `updatePageCount()` periodically, not measured as wall-clock seconds.

### Key Limitations

1. **Page-level only**: No sub-page interactions (clicks, scroll, video progress, quiz attempts) are tracked in real-time.
2. **No time-on-page in the live layer**: Duration tracking exists only in the analytics persistence layer via periodic increment calls -- it is a counter, not a true elapsed-time measurement.
3. **Latest-only persistence**: `tutors-connect-latest` stores one row per student per course (upsert), so historical navigation sequences are lost. The live dashboard reconstructs "this week" views from timestamps, but each student has exactly one stored snapshot.
4. **Opt-in visibility**: Students must toggle "Share Presence" to be visible. Anonymous users (`fullName === "Anon"`) are filtered from all views.
5. **No offline replay**: PartyKit is a pure relay -- once a WebSocket message is missed, it is gone. There is no message queue or event log.
6. **No aggregation or heatmaps**: The live dashboard shows individual student cards but provides no aggregate views (e.g., "15 students on Lab 3 right now" or "average time on Topic 2").
7. **Sentiment is self-reported**: The `sentiment` field comes from a student-set preference stored in `tutors-connect-users`, not inferred from behavior.
